data.rollover_scope: Three-step nonvacuous SAT property of the actual descriptor-rings public outputs. Assume a defined arbitrary enabled/drained queue with consumer 0xffffffff, reset released, and an observed accepted forward producer doorbell to zero. The resulting one-pending-descriptor state becomes consumer zero and drained on retirement. SAT separately finds a witness satisfying every assumption. This covers the actual 32-bit producer/consumer wrap transition, not reset reachability or 2^32 simulated transfers.
